title: Unit Event — Backlight, Lens Flare — Episode5 Cinematic Techniques

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime's next step is to appear as extras in a film! Each of them is enthusiastic about this opportunity to work their magic on camera, and Rui is particularly eager to learn about a different type of directing. However, not everything goes smoothly...

rows.Line: A few days later
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Assistant Director
rows.Line: Alright, let's take a break here!

rows.Speaker: Film Crew
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Now then...
While everyone eats, I should go over what we just took.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mind if I join you?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Whoa, Kamishiro!
I don't mind, but you're going to miss lunch again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
That's fine by me.
Learning what I can from you takes priority.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
It is like you to say that.
Still, I'm surprised you haven't gotten bored of watching what I do day in and day out.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Anyway, since you're so eager, I have a little task for you today.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: There's a way to make the scene we just shot a lot better. What do you think it is?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Does it involve use of light and shadow, like in that earlier scene?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In this scene, Katsuyuki and Hajime are still getting to know each other after, having only just met...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Because he still knows next to nothing about her, we could set up a light behind Hajime so that she appears as a mysterious figure from his perspective, while also hinting that she represents a glimmer of hope...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: That's not a bad idea, but lighting will only get you so far.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: There's something else you can use even more effectively. Not props or lights... Think about our surroundings.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Our surroundings?
Are you talking about the weather?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, we often used to make use of the weather since we performed on an outdoor stage... But in the case of film...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Anyway, it's a pain to explain, so just watch and learn. The idea is to make use of lines. By doing that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm happy for Rui, getting to learn about directing from Mr. Ohara.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I couldn't believe it when he said that he's going to be an assistant, but he seems really at home.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: How great would it be if he and Mr. Ohara working together ends up making this film even better?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It's only been a few days since I started working as his assistant...but I feel like I've learned a lot already.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It goes to show that nothing beats real-life experience.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But we have to wrap everything up in a few weeks, so I need to keep doing my best until then.)
A few weeks later
Airport

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: The day's finally arrived...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We're shooting the climax today...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Wow, really...?!
That explains the tension in the air! Everyone looks so serious☆>

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: We'll likely be shooting into the evening, so this may end up being our longest day yet.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Getting to stay at a hotel for the night is also a first. We have to start early at the beach tomorrow morning, so we're probably in for a tough couple of days.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: That being said, the focus of today will be on the first thing we shoot this afternoon.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're talking about the scene where the protagonist and his sister say goodbye to each other at the airport, right?! I've really been looking forward to seeing that☆>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I really love it too!
The Katsuyuki in that scene is so different from how he was in the very beginning...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: And he's come to care so much about Hajime... Just thinking about that gets me right in the heartstrings!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, this climax scene is without a doubt the most significant scene in the film.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (In the beginning of the film, Katsuyuki has no hopes or dreams and simply works each day. He's lost the will to do anything else.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But meeting this woman who claims to be his long-lost sister, Hajime, changes all that. He starts living with this cheerful and free-spirited woman.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Katsuyuki begins to learn to enjoy life after seeing the way his sister lives hers.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (But suddenly, she disappears without saying a word. Katsuyuki goes after her and confronts her in this scene.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The truth is that a doctor told Hajime that she's sick and only has about six months left to live, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. She wanted to use whatever time she had left to settle unfinished business by meeting her long-lost little brother...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: But they end up becoming closer than she was expecting. That makes saying goodbye all the more difficult...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Which is why she disappears without saying anything to Katsuyuki. She didn't want him to feel sad or lonely after she was gone.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But Katsuyuki still doesn't know the truth.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: He asks her why she left without saying anything, and they get into a big argument.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes. The relationship they've been building up suddenly falls apart, which sends Katsuyuki's emotions spiraling out of control...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What's more, for the first time in his life, he's overcome with the feeling that he doesn't want someone to leave him.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Playing him isn't gonna be easy.
I mean, all the complex emotions Katsuyuki feels during this scene...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Yes, I'm very much looking forward to seeing how Bakuno plays him.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mr. Ohara even said how he asked Bakuno to play him specifically because his skills were suited to this scene.)

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line:
The cameras are all set!
Ready to roll whenever!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, it looks like they're about to start.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Then, I'll head back over to where Mr. Ohara is.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Okay!
Good luck, Rui!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Okay, here we go! Scene 143!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Bakuno looks super serious.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
He does...
Based on his expression, I suspect he's already in character.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to seeing how he performs during this scene, but... I'm getting nervous just watching.

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: And...

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Action!
se_event_lensflare_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (First, a shot of Hajime heading towards her boarding gate. She drops her handkerchief as she walks.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We then cut to her kneeling down to pick it up only, to see...)

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “Katsuyuki...?”

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “You came, even though I didn't tell you anything... I guess I should've expected as much from you.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “But it isn't like you to do what you're doing now.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“Why'd you leave without saying a word?
You still haven't told me anything...”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “I still don't even know why you came to see me in the first place...!”

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line:
“No, I...
I just felt like seeing you is all.”

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “So, please. Forget we ever met.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “What...?”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“H-How can you say that...?
You show up out of nowhere, mess with my feelings and...”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “The truth is, I don't care about what's really going on with you... I just...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(He really is an amazing actor.
The way he's reciting these lines...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If that were me, I'd be playing Katsuyuki as furious over how she just left without saying anything.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But Bakuno's weaving in more than just anger and rage. His Katsuyuki is feeling a wild mix of emotions right now...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Bakuno really was the perfect choice for this scene. Only he can do Katsuyuki justice...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (However...)

rows.Speaker: Hajime
rows.Line: “I'm sorry.”
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Hajime, wait!”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line:
“...
I'm guessing that's not even your real name.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “I still don't know anything about you.”

rows.Speaker: Katsuyuki
rows.Line: “Absolutely nothing...”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Mr. Ohara can feel it too.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(This scene...
There's something off about it...)

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Cut!
se_event_lensflare_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
I'm going to be honest...
That felt all wrong.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: In this scene, Katsuyuki isn't sure how to deal with Hajime leaving or with his attachment to her...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: He should be feeling this torrent of emotions, but that wasn't clear just now.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: A torrent of emotions...?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Are you holding back for some reason, Bakuno?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Your performance just now wasn't what I saw when you were on stage. You lacked the power that made me want you to be the main character of this film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
...!
I was just...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (He's right. Bakuno's performance just now lacked the punch we saw when we were with Shunmeiza.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Which may be because—)

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Yes, you're correct that I was holding back compared to when I'm performing on stage.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: In the theatre, you have to exaggerate everything you say and do so that it reaches everyone in the back.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: So, I was worried that I'd stick out like a sore thumb if I did the same thing for a film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
Please let me try that again.
I'll make some adjustments based on what you just said.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: I promise to nail it during the next take.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Bakuno...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, take two.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Action!
se_event_lensflare_2024_001

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
...
How was that...?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No, still wrong.
As you mentioned earlier, Bakuno, what you just did would work well on stage, but it doesn't translate well to film.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line:
I'm sorry.
I'll try to make more adjustments and...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
No need...
Let's move on from this scene for now.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
That last take told me everything.
It's not a matter of you making minor fixes. There's something fundamentally wrong here that I'm not seeing.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Which means there's no point in reshooting this scene. Not until I figure out what I'm missing.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: O-Okay, I understand...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
What do we do?
At this rate, this scene's gonna...

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line:
We'll try again tomorrow.
Until then, I need to figure out what's wrong.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Tomorrow...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (That may be the best option.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (This is the film's climax. No one here is going to be happy if we don't get it right...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They have until tomorrow to figure out what's wrong, which may just be enough time to figure out what the director's missing.)

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: How are we looking for tomorrow? Can we squeeze in this scene?

rows.Speaker: Crew Member
rows.Line: Yes, if everything else we have on the agenda today goes smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Ohara
rows.Line: Then it's settled. We're done with this scene for now. Let's move on to the next one.

rows.Speaker: Reki
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (It must be hard for Bakuno to leave things unfinished like this.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(But the director's right.
We can shoot retakes all we want, but that alone won't change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (They only have until tomorrow.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I'll also try to figure out what the problem is.)
